scenario: Autónomo, income 50,000, expenses 4,000, SS 3,600, VC, foreign clients only. Each calculation below carries its own oracle, because the annual cuota íntegra and the quarterly advances are checked against different sources.

modelo130.oracleRef: Theory §7.3, ed. 2: Example B quarter by quarter (cumulative income, expenses and payable per quarter, Σ 8,480). The theory table applies no minoración, so previousYear is set above the last band.

rentaTrueUp.oracleRef: SPEC-011 §1 G3 and Theory §7.2, ed. 2, Example B steps 1–10: cuota íntegra 9,548.00, Σ 130 8,480.00, result 1,068.00 a ingresar. With no employment income the whole cuota is the activity's, so liabilityOnActivity is the cuota íntegra and gap is the result. marginalRate is not in the theory; it is the tranche rates at a base of 40,400 (0.185 estatal + 0.175 VC). The theory applies the state mínimo of 5,550 to the regional scale too; the AEAT Manual práctico Renta 2025, cap. 14, gives VC residents a regional mínimo of 6,105 (Ley 13/1997 art. 2 bis), which would lower both figures by 49.95.
